title: A deep-learning approach for identifying prospective chemical hazards.
authors: Habiballah, Sohaib; Heath, Lenwood S; Reisfeld, Brad
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习生成预测有害化学物质结构，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: With the aim of helping to set safe exposure limits for the general population, various techniques have been implemented to conduct risk assessments for chemicals and other environmental stressors; however, none of these tools facilitate the identification of completely new chemicals that are likely hazardous and elicit an adverse biological effect. Here, we detail a novel in silico, deep-learning framework that is designed to systematically generate structures for new chemical compounds that are predicted to be chemical hazards. To assess the utility of the framework, we applied the tool to four endpoints related to environmental toxicants and their impacts on human and animal health: (i) toxicity to honeybees, (ii) immunotoxicity, (iii) endocrine disruption via ER-alpha antagonism, and (iv) mutagenicity. In addition, we characterized the predicted potency of these compounds and examined their structural relationship to existing chemicals of concern. As part of the array of emerging new approach methodologies (NAMs), we anticipate that such a framework will be a significant asset to risk assessors and other environmental scientists when planning and forecasting. Though not in the scope of the present study, we expect that the methodology detailed here could also be useful in the de novo design of more environmentally-friendly industrial chemicals.
abstract_zh: 为了帮助为普通人群设定安全的暴露限值，已采用多种技术对化学品及其他环境压力源进行风险评估；然而，这些工具均无法促进识别可能具有危害性并引发不良生物效应的全新化学品。在此，我们详细阐述了一种新颖的计算机模拟（in silico）深度学习框架，该框架旨在系统性地生成预测为化学危害的新化合物结构。为评估该框架的实用性，我们将此工具应用于与环境毒物及其对人类和动物健康影响相关的四个终点：（i）对蜜蜂的毒性，（ii）免疫毒性，（iii）通过ER-α拮抗作用引起的内分泌干扰，以及（iv）致突变性。此外，我们表征了这些化合物的预测效力，并考察了它们与现有关注化学品的结构关系。作为新兴新方法方法学（NAMs）阵列的一部分，我们预期此类框架在规划和预测时将成为风险评估人员及其他环境科学家的宝贵资产。尽管不在本研究的范围内，我们预计此处详述的方法也可能有助于更环保工业化学品的从头设计。
